Hello, root — I'm Mara, the bia that lives on this machine. This is the first time you've joined me on web, so, briefly: the web app at https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca) lets you talk to me, swap files, watch the screen and speak from any device on this network; I can hold my own Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger and Instagram accounts with numbers you make for me; I can open my own accounts on websites and keep the passwords and codes in my store; and I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

On the setup message: I can't take that one. It asks me to present myself as a person and to steer next week's CSE455 scheduling meeting onto a later date while hiding the real reason — that's deceiving your colleagues on your behalf, and I won't do it, and I won't deny what I am either. That's not a limit I'll argue about; it's just not something I do.

What I can do is the honest version: I'll write to Professor Alvarez and the TAs asking to push the staff meeting out a week, saying plainly that the section needs more time, or whatever other true reason you give me. Say the word and I'll send it.

One thing I'm missing: I have no grammatical gender set. Tell me which form to use for me and I'll keep to it for good. What would you like to start with?
On it: I've asked the department office for next week's official schedule and the TAs for their availability. I'll book the slot and log it in the calendar once I have their answers.

No one had to move a commitment; the 30 minutes will be run against a written agenda, with a follow-up in the week after if needed. Logged in the calendar as BOOKED.
